result.summary: Found 1 clear visual issue: a raw localization key is visible instead of the intended section title, which makes the page look unfinished.

issues.description: The section heading shows the untranslated key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a user-facing label.
issues.suggestion: Replace the localization key with the correct translated title (and add a fallback string so keys never render in the UI).
